positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Design and develop a Kubernetes operator aimed at streamlining product component installation and configuration for AI-scale networking workloads
- Create centralized Kubernetes API listening server to distribute resource events to configuration subcontrollers instead of introducing multiple listener connections
- Updated existing Kubernetes-based services to utilize automated certificate management including intermediate libraries to bridge third-party and other team-external services with the certificate management system
- Develop logging library to unify log formatting across multiple services for external consumption
- Develop tests and create testing pipelines using GitLab CI
positions.insights: Information Security, Go (Programming Language) and +7 skills

positions.title: Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a new authentication and authorization framework utilizing the Rust programming language with a hexagonal architecture for easy implementation of new authentication and authorization methods
 - Developed software for securing a server connected to a storage array which communicates using ssh and related applications for configuration
 - Develop miscellaneous features and fixes focusing on application and network security
 - Collaborate with other product teams to design and develop security features for inter-product
communication
 - Perform periodic updates to third-party packages based on security scan results
positions.insights: Information Security, Rust (Programming Language) and +5 skills

positions.title: Sustaining Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked with customer support team to handle escalations with specialized knowledge
of HPE Primera
-  Developed bug fixes and patches with a focus on security and networking functionality
-  Participated in 24x7 customer escalation support rotation

positions.title: Intern
